stars.encoding: little-endian float32, records of five values stored one after another

record.name: distance
record.description: -1 when there is no reliable distance

record.name: colour_index
record.description: Gaia BP minus RP colour; 99 when there is none

selection: parallax>60 and parallax_over_error>10, merged without duplicates (1462 stars)

bright_stars.encoding: little-endian float32, records of five values stored one after another

record.name: distance
record.description: -1 when there is no reliable distance

record.name: colour_index
record.description: Hipparcos B minus V colour; 99 when there is none

bright_stars.deduplication: Skipped when a Gaia star brighter than G 5 lies within 2 arcminutes

milky_way.orientation: Galactic coordinates with the galactic centre in the middle and the longitude increasing to the left, verified with the Magellanic Clouds
milky_way.processing: Resampled to 4096 by 2048 pixels and saved as JPEG quality 90; the colours are not modified

gaia_bright.description: IRSA Gator gaia_dr3_source, phot_g_mean_mag<8.5, columns ra, dec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp

gaia_nearby.description: IRSA Gator gaia_dr3_source, parallax>60 and parallax_over_error>10, columns ra, dec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp

hipparcos.description: NASA HEASARC TAP: SELECT hip_number, ra, dec, parallax, hip_mag, bv_color FROM hipnewcat WHERE hip_mag < 4.0
